messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated pool eu-west-2 (svc-inference) p99 token latency spike >2s, error budget decreasing. Potential backpressure from large batch requests. Pager: oncall-engineering.

sam: oncall here, jumping in. thanks bot. any customer-facing errors?

maria: I'm seeing increased 503s for a small set of paid tenants — looks correlated with long context lengths and heavy streaming. No overall capacity OOMs on nodes.

kevin: metrics: sustained request RPS up 3x last 10m, CPU/GPU util at ~95% on pool-7, queue latency rising. autoscale hasn't spun new nodes fast enough due to gating.

liz: ETA on manual scale? can we toggle burst capacity while autoscale catches up?

sam: yes. plan proposal: 1) enable burst on pool-7 2) apply soft per-tenant rate limit 60rps 3) disable non-essential features (streaming for X-tier) 4) route reduced models for best-effort tenants.

maria: agree. prioritize customer-impacted tenants, notify support.

sam: executing burst toggle now. command:

```
# enable burst headroom for pool-7
rwctl pool update --pool dedicated-eu-west-2-pool-7 --set burst_enabled=true --note "incident mitigation 1759876543"
```

incident-bot: Action acknowledged: pool update job queued -> job-id 9f3a.

ops-bot: pool-7 burst toggle completed on 3 nodes, headroom ~+20% GPU memory reserved for short-lived jobs.

kevin: good, immediate drop in queue latency. p95 down 400ms in 30s. but GPU util still high. next: applying soft rate cap.

sam: applying rate limit via ratelimit-api:

```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.ratelimit/v1/policy -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN' -d '{"scope":"tenant","limit":60,"window_s":1,"tag":"incident-softcap-1759876543"}'
```

maria: rate cap applied. we're seeing throttles for a handful of heavy tenants. Support: pinged top-5 impacted customers via status page.

liz: I also toggled feature flag disable_streaming_non_paying in LaunchDarkly to true for affected pool to reduce long-lived connections.

sam: great. also doing model routing fallback: traffic for best-effort customers -> small-quantized v2. Routing rule:

`route: dedicated-eu-west-2 -> if tenant.tier == "best-effort" then model = rwd-quant-v2`

kevin: telemetry shows p99 trending back down. still watching. need oncall handoff in 30m if stable.

maria: customers confirmed degraded but functional — no full failures. recording incident impact: degraded latency for 12 tenants, throttled for 4.

sam: notes for postmortem: autoscale gating delayed, burst headroom should auto-enable earlier on sustained queue latency, consider pre-warm policy for long-context workloads.

liz: I'll open follow-up: enable prewarm heuristic + reduce cooldown from 5m -> 90s for this pool.

ops-bot: Reminder: please run `incident-close` when resolved and attach timeline + commands executed.

sam: will hand off to kevin in 30m if no regression. tagging @kevin for 30m oncall handoff.

kevin: acknowledged. monitoring until 1759876860. good job team :thumbsup:
